It accepts only a fresh (75 seconds), exact generation-bound PENDING listener request that agrees with current guardian status; requires RUN_DEMO intent plus the existing maintenance hold; takes a Global recovery mutex; persists the attempt before effect; invokes the released structurally no-order held-readiness assessment; requires GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD/EURUSD with 0 positions and 0 pending orders; then starts/restarts only Forex-M20-Demo-Listener. It records a no-entry receipt requiring a fresh guardian/monitor cycle afterwards. Any stale, malformed, superseded, non-RUN_DEMO, missing-hold, mutex, budget, account, exposure, readiness or task error fails closed. MT5 start/restart/duplicate-client actions explicitly refuse pending separately owned shared-platform primitives; nothing was staged or run on T480. Focused service, executor, guardian, policy, entry-fence and adapter tests passed (214); all new fixed commands measure at most 6618 encoded characters (<7500); diff check passed. 2026-09-26 M33.3 independent Astra review (read-only, no delegated approval): NO-GO for staging/executing the held listener-fault drill. Positives: fixed hash-bound catalog, no generic/order surface, held/no-entry checks, and explicit MT5/duplicate refusal. Blocking defects: absent listener cannot pass readiness; requests/receipts lack action/boot/release/configuration/process/expiry binding; guardian can overwrite INFLIGHT; lifecycle lock/rechecks are incomplete; corrupt state resets budget; no verified post-action guardian/monitor/reconciliation; MT5/duplicate C7 effects remain unavailable. Required local repair: persistent one-active-action state machine with UNKNOWN/crash/timeout handling; immutable active-runtime manifest for absent listener start; shared lock/rechecks; fail-closed corrupt state; post-action verification; separately owned shared MT5 primitives. Chris authorized fingerprint refresh and held-only staging, but review prevents staging/drill until these findings are repaired and re-reviewed. Refresh-fingerprint completed preserving M32 with resulting fingerprint sha256:874f4f8107eab7245f72f962027e005777c1c6b97127bc60b4f11d35ee6e2349; governance validation passed. No T480 operation was run.

2026-09-26 M33.3 remediation phases 0-2 (local only, no staging): added v2 request, ledger and receipt schemas plus docs/design/m33.3-recovery-protocol.md. Guardian now creates identity-bound listener-only requests (request ID, generation, boot, listener/guardian release, configuration, account/profile, status digest and expiry), retains active PENDING ownership, writes an immutable runtime binding, and treats corrupt/unresolved ledger state as CIRCUIT_OPEN/intervention-required. Executor consumes only v2 PENDING requests linked to the current ledger, rechecks RUN_DEMO intent and hold while under its mutex, preserves the attempt ledger before dispatch, and preflights an absent listener from the immutable binding instead of a live listener heartbeat. It records a dispatch only as INTERVENTION_REQUIRED pending post-action reconciliation; it cannot claim recovery. Added schema, guardian and absent-listener preflight regressions; 39 focused policy/guardian/executor tests, compilation and diff check passed. Still required before review/staging: complete locked claim/unknown state transitions and fresh post-action listener/guardian/inventory/monitor verification, then re-review.

The controlled fixed listener stop caused the guardian to issue identity-bound listener-only PENDING request 44a722e7e70444b0800f56e932279bf8 (generation 1; release 62c2acc613566f8a; configuration sha256:824c5263...). The final fixed recovery-status receipt retains the VERIFIED v2 receipt. This proves one held listener recovery only; it neither releases the hold nor grants entry/order authority, and does not prove M33-C7 MT5 recovery, M33.4 reboot/soak, or lifecycle/P&L evidence. Focused M33 adapter tests, governance validation and diff check passed.

2026-09-27 M33.4 verifier preparation and no-order P&L observation: added scripts/verify_m33_final_health_evidence.py with tests. It refuses missing/changed/duplicate receipts and emits FOREX_M33_LOCAL_TRADING_HEALTH_OK only for an exact final-release manifest containing the verified recovery chain, two distinct unattended post-final-release boots, a monotonic 24-hour gap-bounded T16-disconnected soak, and an identity-bound CLOSED_MATCHED AUD broker/P&L PostgreSQL lifecycle row. It rejects a partial/no-trade lifecycle, T16-connected soak and the older M33.1/M33.2 reboot bundle. The fixed m33_broker_pnl_collect operation captured 175 retained Demo broker deals (capture M33PC-37085e38fc1c55fd2184081ccd87becbf02ad814d0b58672e7c12e41f3400708) with no order path. The fixed lifecycle summary contains historical CLOSED_MATCHED rows but they bind earlier releases/fingerprints and cannot be reused as current M33-C8 lifecycle proof. Targeted final/legacy health and M33 tests, governance validation and diff check passed. M33-C7 MT5/duplicate recovery and the final reviewed release remain prerequisites to final soak capture.

2026-09-27 shared MT5 recovery dependency audit: the governed cs-ai-lab-infra catalogue at pinned revision ad3d707971cfab2a5bce8aa8ddd9ccf096b1182c exposes read-only mt5_status and generic approval-required mt5_start/mt5_startup_enable only. It has no identity-bound M33 managed-MT5 recovery or flat-only duplicate-client recycle operation. The generic start lacks the M33-C7 request/boot/release/configuration/account/profile binding, shared mutex, held no-order exposure/unresolved-work gates, attributable duplicate ownership check and mandatory reconciliation receipt. It must not be used as an M33 recovery substitute. The exact cross-owner contract remains docs/design/m33.3-shared-mt5-recovery-proposal.md; implementation/review by the shared owner plus a specific operator authorisation are required before MT5 recovery proof can proceed.
